title: Legacy timing bypasses the 4096-event request bound
symptom: Legacy timing consumes more than 4096 transition records without a partial warning
trigger: A checkpoint without history_cursor and more than 4096 valid JSONL transitions below the 16 MiB byte limit
expected: Every timing request processes at most 4096 events and explicitly reports omitted earlier history
actual: 5000 records and segments are processed with partial empty
impact: P2: approved request work bound is not enforced for legacy projects

notes.text: status: open -> verified. Shared history event limit now applies before parsing legacy transitions; independent failing input and exact boundary regressions are retained. Dedicated executable case: TC-cli-history-legacy-timing-bounds.
